bio: Fleekz is the artist Black identified as the one behind 2K23 Corner$, which a live Spotify API check on 2026-09-14 showed under Appears On on That Boy Hi Hat's artist page. CWI's Global Alt-Rap Protocol names Montego Bay, Jamaica as the origin point for Fleekz and Dre50. Multiple same-name profiles exist on Spotify — they are not the collaborator and must not be confused with him. Verified profile link pending — Black can supply confirmed bio details.
